acquisition_method.evidence: Data acquisition was achieved in a positive polarity mode using a data-dependent top-10 method where the most abundant precursor ions from the survey scan (350-1,750 m/z) were dynamically chosen for higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein extracts were then reduced in 12 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP; Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min at 60˚C followed by alkylation in 50 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
